settings_changed: Outward-message settings changed. This approval was not applied. Refresh settings and request approval again.
identity_change: Change the default outward-message sender to {identity}. Existing message grants remain bound to their approved identity. A bot failure never falls back to your account.
scope_changed: The authorization, recipient, or sender changed. Nothing was sent. Refresh the settings and confirm the intended scope.
already_delivered: This send ID was delivered earlier. This attempt sent nothing, and does not verify the attempted text. Inspect the previous message at its destination before retrying.
